$comment: Single source of truth. Everything under dist/ is generated from this by build.py. Never edit dist/ by hand.

meta.name: Nullglow
meta.description: Near-black cyberpunk, tuned rather than eyeballed. Every colour clears WCAG AA against the ground and stays separable under colour-vision deficiency.
meta.author: mahoudeau
meta.credit: The look started with 0daybeats.com. No colour value is taken from it. See the derivation below.

$derivation.$comment: Why these numbers and not others. Re-checkable with `python3 build.py --check`.
$derivation.ground: Near-black with a faint GREEN bias, tying it to the primary. Deliberately not the blue-biased near-blacks that most cyberpunk themes use.
$derivation.accents: No stock maximum-saturation values (#00ff88 / #00ffff / #ff0080 and friends). Each accent was moved off the obvious value and then tuned against two constraints.

constraints.contrast: every role clears 4.5:1 (WCAG AA) against ground, including comment, which most themes let fail
constraints.separation: every accent pair sits at ΔE >= 25 in CIELAB
constraints.colour_vision: every accent pair stays at ΔE >= 18 under simulated deuteranopia

$roles.$comment: What each role MEANS. build.py maps these onto every target, so a role is defined once and stays consistent from editor to prompt to diff.
$roles.surface: panels, widgets, input fields, ANSI black
$roles.comment: comments, ghost text, ANSI bright black
$roles.red: errors and diagnostics only. Kept distinct from pink on purpose

$notes.pink: kirby-pink. Picked because I liked it, before it had to pass anything. It passes anyway.
$notes.purple: Lifted to #d79bff so blue and purple stay apart for deuteranopic readers. They collide at ΔE 15.9 in the obvious violet.
$notes.comment: Sits at 4.56:1. Most themes let comments fail AA. This one doesn't.

nullglow-neon.label: Nullglow Neon
nullglow-neon.$comment: Same neutrals as the default variant, accents pushed to maximum chroma. Found by searching 240k candidates for the most saturated palette that still passes all three rules. Louder without giving up accessibility.

$notes.chroma: Mean CIELAB chroma 81.7 against the default variant's 58.7. 39% more saturated.
$notes.purple: #c312f9 sits at 4.51:1, the tightest margin in either variant. It clears AA, but only just.
$notes.why: Pure #00ff88, #00ffff and #ff0080 are banned in the search. Those are verbatim values from the site that started this. The neon here is mine.

derive.$comment: Bright ANSI colours are computed, not hand-picked, so they stay consistent.
